startIntro: Bring your products, your skills and your business to neighbours across Delta State.
sellProductsHint: Create listings for phones, fashion, food and everyday finds. Reach buyers near you.
offerServicesHint: Showcase your skills, set your service area and connect with local customers.
acceptTerms: I have read and accept the seller terms
acceptTermsRequired: Please accept the seller terms to continue.
termsUnavailable: The seller terms couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
businessPageHint: Your shop's name, location, opening hours and photos, shown next to every product.
providerPageHint: Your name or trade name, experience, rates and photos of your work, shown next to every service.
listingsCardHint: Add products and services, publish them and pause them when you are away.

statusHint.draft: Only you can see this. Publish it when it's ready.
statusHint.pending_review: A WHY ME moderator is checking it. This usually takes less than a day.
statusHint.paused: Hidden from buyers until you resume it.
statusHint.expired: This has expired. Publish it again to show it to buyers.

noReason: No reason was given. Contact WHY ME support.
profileIntro: This is what buyers see on your page. Don't add phone numbers, emails, bank details or links: buyers contact and pay you through WHY ME.
aboutHint: At least 20 characters. What you do, for how long, and what buyers can expect.
availabilityHint: For example: Monday to Saturday, 8am to 6pm
openingHoursHint: Untick the days you are closed.
serviceAreasHint: Buyers in these LGAs will find you.
profilePhotos: Photos of your shop or work
photosHint_one: Up to {{count}} photo. The first one is the cover.
photosHint_other: Up to {{count}} photos. The first one is the cover.
listingTitleHintService: For example: House wiring and fault finding
descriptionHintProduct: Condition, size, colour, what's included. At least 10 characters.
descriptionHintService: What the job includes, what buyers should prepare. At least 10 characters.
priceInvalid: Enter an amount in naira, for example 15000.
quantityHint: Leave empty if you don't count stock.
photoRejected: This photo couldn't be read. Remove it and try another.
photoWaiting: No connection. Kept on this device.
photoType: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
photoLimit_other: You can add up to {{count}} photos here.
waitForPhotos: Wait for your photos to finish uploading.
publishHint: New pages and listings may be checked by a moderator before buyers see them.
editLiveWarning: This is live. Saving changes may send it back for a quick review.
submittedReview: Sent for review. We'll show it to buyers once a moderator has checked it.
submittedLive: Published. Buyers can see it now.
conflictReloaded: This was changed on another device. We loaded the latest version; check it and save again.
paused: Paused. Buyers can't see it until you resume it.
needsCapability: Turn on selling for your account first.
inReviewLocked: A moderator is checking this, usually within a day. You can make changes again once the review is done.
hoursInvalid: Closing time must be after opening time.
yearsInvalid: Enter a number of years, for example 5.
quantityInvalid: Enter a whole number, for example 10.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: What you have earned through WHY ME Protected Payment, and where WHY ME sends it.

totals.awaiting_delivery_hint: Paid by buyers; yours once they confirm they got it.
totals.on_hold_hint: A problem was reported, or WHY ME is checking the order.
totals.awaiting_release_hint: Buyers confirmed. Open the order to request your payout; WHY ME approves each one.
totals.being_paid: On its way to your bank

payouts.accountIntro: WHY ME pays you only into a bank account in your name. Only you and WHY ME finance see it.
payouts.noAccount: Add the bank account WHY ME should pay you into. You can't be paid until you do.
payouts.nameIs: The bank says this account belongs to:
payouts.notYou: Not you? Check the number and the bank.
payouts.coolingOff: Changed recently: payouts resume after {{date}}. This protects you if someone else changed it.
payouts.noPayouts: No payouts yet. When WHY ME releases an order's money, it shows here.

payoutState.requested: Asked for, waiting for WHY ME

payouts.loadFailed: Couldn't load your payouts. Check your connection.

workspace.hoursIntro: Let customers know when they can visit or get in touch.
workspace.serviceDetailsHint: Tell customers where you work and what to expect.
workspace.photosIntro: A clear logo and real photos help customers recognise and trust you.
workspace.previewHint: A few words about what you do will help your neighbours get to know your business.
workspace.previewNote: A quick preview of your details. Your public page has its own layout.
workspace.beforePublish: A little care before you share.

workspace.listingsIntro: Your products and services, all in one place. Create something new or keep your existing listings up to date.
workspace.noMatches: Nothing in this corner just yet.

workspace.listingBasicsHint: A clear title and useful details make a good first impression.

workspace.payoutsGuide: Follow every stage of your earnings.

workspace.accountLoadFailed: We couldn't load your payout account. Try again before making changes.

overview.eyebrow: A little local. A lot of possibility.
overview.heroIntro: Your products, your skills, your corner of the market. Everything you need to reach your next customer is right here.
overview.pagesHint: Give buyers a place to get to know you and what you do.
overview.pagesReady: Your pages are ready for neighbours to discover.
overview.pagesIntro: Help customers put a name, a face and a story to your business.

overview.emptyTitle: Your first good find starts here.

overview.tipsTitle: Make your next listing a great one.

overview.whatToOffer: What would you like to offer?
overview.chooseBoth: Choose products, services, or both. You can add the other option later.

returnDaysInvalid: Enter a number of days from 1 to 30.

returns.title: Returns and refunds
returns.hintProduct: Tell buyers whether you take items back. WHY ME checks it before buyers see it; your listing stays live meanwhile.
returns.hintService: Tell clients whether you give refunds. WHY ME checks it before clients see it; your listing stays live meanwhile.
returns.unset: Not stated (WHY ME buyer protection only)
returns.daysHint: Counted from delivery, pickup or the finished job.
returns.conditionsHint: For example: unused, in the original box. No phone numbers or links.
returns.pending: WHY ME is checking your returns policy. Buyers see it once it's approved.
returns.rejected: WHY ME didn't approve this policy:

offline.savedOnDevice: Saved on this device. It will be sent when you're back online.
offline.savedPublishLater: Saved on this device. It will be published when you're back online.
offline.waiting: Your changes are saved on this device and will be sent when you're back online.
offline.conflict: This was changed somewhere else while your changes waited. Your changes are still here: check them and save again.
offline.inReview: WHY ME is checking this, so your changes can't be sent yet. Save again after the check, or discard them.
offline.photoRejected: A photo couldn't be sent. Remove it and save again.
offline.needsAuth: Sign in again to send your changes.
offline.notStored: This browser couldn't keep your changes (its storage may be full). Nothing was saved.
offline.pendingHint: Saved on this device. They're sent by themselves when you're online.
offline.discardConfirm: Discard the unsent changes to “{{title}}”? This can't be undone.
offline.waitingPublish: Your changes are saved on this device. They will be sent and published when you're back online.
